- **Keep filesystem access rooted and sanitized.** Serve logs from a fixed directory, normalize paths, reject anything resolving outside that root, and sanitize any filename before using it in a path. cpp-httplib maps a URL prefix to a local directory, rejects symlink escapes outside the mount, and strips separators/NULs/`.`/`..` in `sanitize_filename()`.  
  - https://github.com/yhirose/cpp-httplib/blob/008e107d0fcddee7cb96dc5ad3c3189fd090e40a/docs-src/pages/en/tour/04-static-file-server.md#L10-L26
